fixes.explanation: True, baker. Verse 7 says, "With these words David restrained his men, and he did not let them rise up against Saul." (1 Samuel 24:7). Those men had just said it was the day, and David still held them back. He did it with his words. Afterward, his own conscience was stricken just for cutting off the corner of Saul's robe.

That's it, baker. "Then Saul left the cave and went on his way." (1 Samuel 24:7). He walks out while David is holding his men back. Quiet exit, and a corner of his robe is already gone (1 Samuel 24:4). Then David gets up, goes out of the cave, and calls out to him.

Priest is a respectable job, but nobody is handing David a priest's robe in this scene. Saul says, "Now I know for sure that you will be king…" (1 Samuel 24:20). He goes on to say the kingdom of Israel will be established in David's hands. That's a lot bigger than a priest's job, friend.
